Upstream rebuilds Sundays 14:00 CEST, so this trailing date is the normal cadence, not a freeze. Era-gated: it never entered the consensus.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, merged via apply-metrics.mjs survivability key. 21 of 40 tiers moved, every one by exactly ONE band and 20 of them DOWNWARD (Enhancement Shaman S->A, six A->B, thirteen B->C; Brewmaster Monk C->B is the lone upward move). This is the mirror image of yesterday's 18 mostly-upward moves on the 08-06 cut, i.e. the same death-rate re-clustering oscillating back on Archon's new 2026-08-07T12:00:00Z cut — the cut whose throughput/score letters moved zero. Survivability is a death-rate cluster, not a rating; nothing here feeds the letter consensus.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200 on plain curl (161 KB). 44 blocks; whitelisted categoryType dps|hps|tank (melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count) + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined = 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, class/spec byte-identical to the roster, merged at the stored 2-decimal precision with 0 of 40 values and every n unchanged. PARTIAL, not success, because asOf is the SOURCE's snapshotDate and it did NOT advance: manifest.json still reads snapshotDate 2026-08-05 (completedAt 2026-08-05T03:22:11Z), the same cut yesterday's run saw, so the stored coverage date stays 2026-08-05 — three days behind this run. That is the lag the skill says to record as partial rather than claim as fresh; maxAgeDays 8 is not breached, but this is now two consecutive nights with no upstream pipeline run.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. Its only WCL input is wcl-fetch/evidence.json, written by the deterministic pre-agent step at 2026-08-08T11:03:50Z: verdict "rdps-broken" — characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returned HTTP 200 with a bare "Internal server error" and 0 rankings, so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. OAuth and GraphQL transport both report ok (rate limit 3600/h, 1 point spent), which isolates the fault to the rdps metric family exactly as documented in the refresh-metrics skill. evidence.landed carries no entry for this key, so the zone-46 Mythic medians could not honestly land and the 47 stored rows were LEFT UNTOUCHED at 2026-08-07 (1 day, against maxAgeDays 10).

All 42 unique feeds polled live (39 transcribable class-creator channels + Maximum, Zorthas and izen as generalCreators), 42/42 HTTP 200 on the first attempt, no retries needed; 630 RSS entries scanned. yt-dlp was NOT invoked, installed or upgraded, and no transcript API or YouTube page was fetched by this agent. transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict "ok", requested 0 / fetched 0 — the queue was empty at step start (the three videos the 08-07 nightly queued were drained and distilled by the local run that followed it; all three ids now appear in creator-takes.json urls), so there was nothing to distil this run: 0 takes, 0 metaNotes, 0 superseded. SEEN-SET is structured, per the 2026-08-08 rule: union of pending-transcripts.json seen[] (432) + skipped[] (95) + videos[] (0) and every youtu.be id in creator-takes.json = 660 ids, no log.md regex. That surfaced 153 unseen videos — far more than a normal night, because the creator roster grew from 25 to 42 feeds since the last nightly and a newly-added creator's whole 15-entry feed reads as unseen. Every one of the 153 falls on or after the 12.1 cycle's opening build (2026-06-18), so the date bound dismissed none. QUEUED 25 (queue 0 -> 25, the PER_RUN_CAP), keyword-filtered as the nightly must be (Supadata free tier is 100 requests/MONTH) and prioritised by scarcity then recency: the two uncovered specs a creator actually covers (Sam + Obli on Frost DK, LBNinja7 on Oracle Holy Priest), raid- and tank-scoped content (Tactyks x2 on Protection Paladin incl. "The State of Raiding in Patch 12.1", Sha x2 on Brewmaster/tank comparisons — the lane CLAUDE.md records as having zero raid-scoped tank takes), healers (MadSkillzzTV x3, Megasett), then Jedith x2, NeekapHere, Musguete x2, leak x2, Kesslive, Pkpawner, Whispyr, Hopeful, Bansherz, and two generalCreator videos for the metaNotes lane (Zorthas, Maximum). DELIBERATE RESTRAINT ON seen[]: only 8 ids were added (Maximum's Path of Exile Season 3 stream VODs — "SSF Sorc", "trying to loot new lego", etc. — obviously not WoW at all). The other ~120 in-cycle videos were NOT marked seen even though this nightly's keyword filter passed over them, because marking them would also hide them from the next LOCAL run, whose yt-dlp sweep is supposed to judge them on transcripts rather than titles — that is exactly the failure the 2026-08-08 rule was written about. FOR A HUMAN: MadSkillzzTV and LBNinja7 both carry Holy Paladin / Holy Priest scope entries, so their healer videos queued in scope; Obli's registered specs are Frost and Unholy, so his Frost DK video is in scope while his Blood DK interview from 08-06 still is not. No creator opinion touched any rating.
